entities.name: Garth One-Eye
entities.description: A powerful wizard and planeswalker from Kush on Dominaria, born Galin, who loses his left eye as a child and takes revenge on Kuthuman.

entities.name: Cullinarn
entities.description: Garth's father, master of the House of Oor-tael, who teleports Garth and his mother from the fire.

entities.name: House of Oor-tael
entities.description: A green-blue house destroyed by Kuthuman.

entities.name: Kuthuman
entities.description: The Grand Master of the Arena of Estark, who destroyed Oor-tael on a quest to become a planeswalker and is defeated by Garth.

entities.name: Zarel
entities.description: Kuthuman's servant who gouges out Garth's left eye and later becomes Grand Master.

entities.name: Estark
entities.description: The place of the Arena where Garth returns to win the tournament.

entities.name: Night of Fire
entities.description: The burning of House Oor-tael when Garth was five.

entities.name: Time of Troubles
entities.description: The period of Garth's return to Estark and the tournament.

entities.name: Hammen
entities.description: A former servant of Oor-tael who befriended Garth; also the name of Garth's child with Norreen.

entities.name: Norreen
entities.description: A Benalish soldier who becomes Garth's partner and mother of his child.

entities.name: Varena
entities.description: A Fentesk fighter with whom Garth had a brief romance, who helps rescue him from prison.

entities.name: Bolk
entities.description: The leader under whose colors Garth fought during the Festival.

entities.name: Silmar
entities.description: A fighter paired with Garth in a fight to the death, which Garth won.

entities.name: Ulin
entities.description: An eighth-rank fighter Garth fights on the second day.

entities.name: Gish
entities.description: The countryside where Garth and Norreen retire to grow a vineyard.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: The place to which Norreen and Hammen are kidnapped.

entities.name: Gull
entities.description: A leader Garth fights thinking he was the kidnapper; Garth later helps return his army to their homelands.

entities.name: Greensleeves
entities.description: A figure who brings Garth to his senses and receives his spell satchel.

entities.name: Sabriam
entities.description: A figure whose death precedes the rescue of Norreen and Hammen.

entities.name: Kirlen
entities.description: Researcher of the spell that could grant planeswalking powers to anyone.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Garth's home plane.

events.summary: Zarel gouges out the young Garth's left eye during the Night of Fire, and Cullinarn teleports Garth and his mother away.
events.quote: Cullinarn used the last of his power to teleport Garth and his mother far away from the fire.

events.summary: After twenty years in exile, Garth returns to Estark under a false name to win the tournament and meet Kuthuman.
events.quote: After twenty years in exile, he returned to Estark under the false name of Garth

events.summary: Garth meets Hammen and Norreen, incites riots, is captured, and is rescued from prison by Norreen, Hammen and Varena.
events.quote: He was rescued from prison by Norreen, Hammen, and Varena

events.summary: Zarel rigs the first round so Garth must fight Silmar to the death; Garth wins.
events.quote: Zarel rigged the choosing so that Garth was paired with Silmar

events.summary: Garth defeats Kuthuman and uses a spell to steal his ability to planeswalk.
events.quote: Garth was successful in defeating Kuthuman

events.summary: Garth willingly gives up planeswalking to live with Norreen.
events.quote: he willingly gave up planeswalking to live with the Benalish woman

events.summary: Garth finds leaving his powers behind hard and resumes journeying between planes; Norreen and Hammen are kidnapped to Benalia.
events.quote: Norreen and Hammen were kidnapped and brought to Benalia

events.summary: Garth attacks Gull and Greensleeves believing they were the kidnappers, then is calmed and promises never to abandon his family.
events.quote: Garth admitted the wrongness of his ways

events.summary: Garth gives his spell satchel to Greensleeves and offers his knowledge of Dominaria to bring Gull's army home.
events.quote: giving up his spells' satchel to Greensleeves

events.summary: In a 2021 retcon, Garth's spark is said to have ignited when he won vengeance against the killer of his kin.
events.quote: Garth's planeswalker spark ignited at the moment he won vengeance
